description: Extract and normalize the governing law or jurisdiction explicitly stated in a contract clause.

problems.prompt: Identify the governing law or jurisdiction stated in the provided contract clause. Return a single JSON object containing exactly one key: "jurisdiction". Normalize the value to the standard full legal name (e.g., "New York", "Delaware", "England and Wales", "Federal law of the United States"). If the clause does not specify a governing law, return the value "Not specified". Output only the JSON object.

args: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict of laws principles.
The internal laws of the State of Delaware shall govern all matters arising out of this Contract.
This agreement is subject to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales.
These Terms of Service are governed by the Federal law of the United States.

expected.jurisdiction: Federal law of the United States
